scope: Product-wide planning story map; L1 detailed stories delegated to coordinator

authority.synthetic_local_dev_fixture_development: previously authorised and separately prepared; no new fixture implementation in this map

actual_status.backend: health endpoint and local unauthenticated volatile sample SSE only
actual_status.preview: static concept; not planned SvelteKit PWA
actual_status.synthetic: local/dev 30-real-ID market/ledger packs and clean generic PDF/PNG/operations companion fixtures documented as prepared; no parser/application proof
actual_status.product_features: not implemented; no phase exit certified

id_policy: Lx-Sxx are local draft IDs, never MP keys. L1 IDs live only in the delegated detailed map. No Jira issues were created.

phases.title: Complete baseline and contract decisions
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
deliverables: Versioned shared contracts and approval boundary
UX/state inventory and local prototype acceptance plan
phases.exit_gate: Complete draft layers now; whole baseline and UX still need owner approval.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Keep unresolved choices explicit; no application implementation or external writes.

phases.title: Standalone portfolio, all-method imports and source lineage
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
phases.exit_gate: All CSV/Excel/PDF/screenshot/manual methods remain first-version requirements; supported layouts have sample-backed coverage and uncertain values require confirmation.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Quarantine uncertain extraction; retain originals; reverse confirmed imports through audited ledger events, never silent deletion.

phases.title: Identity, private runtime, audit and launch cost controls
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
phases.exit_gate: Foundation safeguards and cost attribution must precede paid jobs, real documents and external activation.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Fail closed for unknown paid-call coverage; stop optional work; retain durable state and deterministic reads.

phases.title: Market data, performance and portfolio risk
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
phases.exit_gate: Synthetic mappings can be specified now; live listing/rights/pricing evidence is required only before live activation.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Display stale/partial status,fall back to eligible daily analysis,suppress unsupported alerts and preserve last trusted values.

phases.title: Scientific baseline, full Forecaster and controlled learning
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
phases.exit_gate: Every agreed horizon is in the product baseline; eligibility depends on mature evidence and never on synthetic success.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Keep challenger in shadow/disabled; revert to prior compatible approved baseline/model without rewriting historic outputs.

phases.title: Evidence research, agents, chat and evaluations
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
phases.exit_gate: LLM research stays grounded/read-only; numerical models and realised-outcome validation remain separate.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Abort bounded loop,deny tools,quarantine tainted material and return deterministic/abstaining views with a run audit.

phases.title: Web discovery, ranked actions, proof and briefings
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
deliverables: Approved local PWA design and state inventory
Web journey and accessibility acceptance pack
phases.exit_gate: Launch includes discovery-first web,all import methods,priority cost view,chat,all horizon sections and honest disabled/unavailable states.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Hide no uncertainty; disable ineligible ranked claims and paid analysis,retain ledger/audit/cost/freshness access.

phases.title: Native Apple, offline and push
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
deliverables: Native and PWA push acceptance plan
phases.exit_gate: First-version native/PWA push fallbacks follow verified platform capability; advanced integrations need an explicit launch/later choice.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Revoke affected session/cache,fall back to in-app notices and stale-labelled read cache; no unsafe offline financial writes.

phases.title: Operational acceptance and controlled personal launch
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
deliverables: Release evidence,admin requirements and owner runbook
phases.exit_gate: Release approval and deployment/spending authority are separate; existing MP status and this draft certify neither.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Pause optional work,schedules or affected feature; replay only bounded idempotent jobs;restore isolated target and reconcile before switch.

phases.title: Versioned extensions and conditional future transfer
entry_requirements: Layer requirements,contracts,local stories,UX states and acceptance evidence defined
Full end-to-end baseline and UX approval before any application implementation
phases.exit_gate: Future markets and families remain retained scope with per-extension evidence and owner approval; no implied budget increase.
phases.failure_or_rollback: Deactivate extension and roll back version pointer while preserving history; no MA retirement without separately approved cutover.

stories.title: Reconcile full scope and approval boundary
stories.user_need: Understand what is included before any application work starts.
acceptance_criteria: Trace DEC-001–041, CAP-01–19 and the 140 captured source stories to planned phases, preserving differences from historical source wording.
Record current health/sample SSE/static preview separately from planned product capabilities; actual holdings and documents remain deferred.

Obtain an explicit full end-to-end requirements and UX decision after all layers have specifications, contracts, local stories and reviewed design options; a phase draft or fixture pass is insufficient.
required_evidence: Decision-to-phase matrix; open-choice register; owner approval record or explicit unapproved status

stories.title: Select architecture and cost assumptions
stories.user_need: Choose a deliverable platform within the cash ceiling.
acceptance_criteria: Compare active A lean AWS training versus B selective SageMaker training without declaring either selected; both retain Lambda and the direct Anthropic client-SDK loop.
Price full launch scope across dev/prod/data/models/evals/builds/storage/notifications and fixed subscriptions within £70 planned plus £30 reserve; record unverified credit as unverified.
Resolve or explicitly escalate old local-PostgreSQL/host assumptions and the historical £50 AWS target through approved ADRs; no cloud changes follow from a draft.
required_evidence: Option ADR draft; dated price/rights assumptions; full-scope cash stress case with no usable credit

stories.title: Freeze shared versioned contracts and state semantics
stories.user_need: Keep clients, data, agents and experiments compatible.
acceptance_criteria: Define instrument/listing, money/FX, timestamps/known-at, event, ledger, forecast/task/horizon, model, agent, strategy and evaluation contracts with version/error/compatibility rules.
Define contract owners and change review; every record links relevant schema/data/code versions and no-trading authority.
Specify durable-state recovery independently of SSE delivery and preserve additive correction semantics.
required_evidence: Schema examples; compatibility and migration cases; contract ownership table

stories.title: Approve cross-client product flows
stories.user_need: See the whole personal investment journey before coding.
acceptance_criteria: Cover discovery-first dashboard, separate holdings/imports, per-horizon forecasts/proof, research/chat, action journal, cost visibility, owner approvals and privacy/recovery flows.
Document loading/empty/error/stale/offline/no-model/disagreement/abstention states and accessibility on web, iPhone, iPad and adaptive Duo layouts.

Verify the requested SvelteKit 3 version against current official availability before choosing packages; do not imply it is installed. Agree native/device support and local design/prototype before any authorised Sites sync.
required_evidence: Local user-flow and state inventory; design options and explicit selection; version/device evidence

stories.title: Define synthetic acceptance coverage and future real-sample intake
stories.user_need: Progress now without pretending sample layouts prove broker compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Index existing local/dev synthetic 30-real-ID packs and PDF/PNG/expected-import/operations companions; mark prices, accounts, transactions and outcomes synthetic.
Identify missing Excel, malformed/blurred/rotated/protected/hostile documents and add to planned coverage; existing clean fixtures do not prove parser robustness or forecast accuracy.
Allow actual screenshots/PDFs to arrive progressively through later private intake; no current planning exit requires them.
required_evidence: Fixture coverage matrix; deferred real-sample register; labelled expected outputs

stories.title: Cognito identity and owner recovery
stories.user_need: Reach my own data safely across devices.
acceptance_criteria: Specify managed Apple/Google/passkey sign-in and server-verified account linking; email similarity alone cannot merge identities.
Define two independent passkey paths, verified provider links, lost-device/recovery proof, session revocation and sensitive-action reauthentication.
Demonstrate denied cross-environment/cross-owner access and audit recovery/link changes without exposing identity tokens.
required_evidence: Threat model and auth contracts; recovery/linking negative scenarios; eventual web/native integration results

stories.title: Private durable storage and job contracts
stories.user_need: Keep changes durable despite interrupted jobs.
acceptance_criteria: Specify isolated dev/prod identities and encrypted storage with least privilege; synthetic dev cannot write production.
Specify conditional ledger/audit/outbox writes and S3 hash/manifest publication boundaries; uploaded bytes and database pointers are not one transaction.
Retries use idempotency keys, bounded backoff and quarantine; no duplicate financial side effect after timeout/replay.
required_evidence: Access-pattern model; write-failure matrix; planned idempotency/fault-injection cases

stories.title: Launch dashboard cost meter and reconciliation
stories.user_need: Know combined cost before enabling paid workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Main dashboard shows dev/prod/local API/shared-unallocated costs with provider/agent/model/feature/service drill-down and source age.
Separate live estimates from delayed billing and gross usage from credit applied/cash; Anthropic billing collection every 6 hours, AWS daily, bounded and cached.
Unknown shared credit stays unknown and is never multiplied per environment; show collector failures and reconciliation discrepancies.
required_evidence: Cost event and allocation schemas; dashboard states; stale/unknown/adjusted-bill synthetic cases

stories.title: Enforce discretionary spending admission
stories.user_need: Keep paid work within approved operating policy.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate forecast monthly cash against £60 warning/£75 reduced optional work/£85 pause-new-optional-paid thresholds while retaining £100 total ceiling and £70+£30 plan.
Use bounded reservations/limits for concurrent jobs; refuse uncovered or unverifiable Claude calls and pause optional calls at agreed low-credit conditions without paid fallback.
Show uncertainty from delayed AWS billing; approval thresholds are not claimed to provide an instantaneous universal AWS shutoff. Keep deterministic essential views available.
required_evidence: Admission state table; concurrent-reservation and unknown-credit cases; full-workload stress budget

stories.title: Authenticated API and resumable SSE
stories.user_need: Recover the correct view after network or app interruption.
acceptance_criteria: Version authenticated APIs and short-lived heartbeat-enabled SSE; use durable event IDs/cursor recovery where supported, refetch durable records after gaps.
Define reconnect/token-expiry/ordering/dedup/backpressure and multi-tab/background rules; no secrets or durable financial truth solely in a stream.
Cost active connections and validate selected API/Lambda streaming compatibility before implementation; starter unauthenticated volatile SSE is not production evidence.
required_evidence: API/event examples; disconnect/expired-session cases; streaming compatibility and cost evidence

stories.title: Telemetry, evidence separation and original archive
stories.user_need: Investigate a run without leaking financial documents.
acceptance_criteria: Plan logs 14 days, rich traces 30, run summaries 90 subject to measured cost; maintain distinct durable financial/forecast/approval/source audit lifecycles.
Plan encrypted private S3 originals with renewable 24-month retention and owner extension/deletion controls; define versions/derivatives/backups and no automatic expiry deletion yet.
Redact document contents, holdings, tokens and prompts from operational telemetry; correlation IDs link to access-controlled evidence.
required_evidence: Record-class retention table; redaction cases; source-to-ledger/model audit examples

stories.title: Instrument identity, entitlement and cadence
stories.user_need: Know which listing and actual data support each analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Support initial UK/US/India 20–30 real-ID synthetic instruments, preserving issuer/security/listing/venue, GBP/GBX/local currencies and NAV versus OHLC semantics.
Before live activation, resolve owner identities and source rights/history/latency/storage for Yahoo plus exact Twelve Data Grow tier; then propose the balanced research watchlist for owner approval.

Record source capability by listing; 30-minute risk/quote refresh only where supported, otherwise daily labelled analysis and suppressed unsupported intraday alerts; no paid provider addition without approval.
required_evidence: Listing/capability matrix; entitlement evidence before live; ambiguous/dual-listing/GBX/NAV cases

stories.title: Point-in-time ingestion and data health
stories.user_need: Use history that was actually available at the decision time.
acceptance_criteria: Pin source publication/observation/ingestion/known-at times, corporate actions, FX/calendar versions and quality flags.
Backfill toward ten years or inception where entitled; gaps/revisions/partial exposure history remain explicit and cannot be replaced by current constituents.
Handle provider disagreement, missing bars, market holidays/half-days/DST, quota failures and safe daily fallback with provenance.
required_evidence: Provider contract fixtures; ingestion/revision/gap cases; per-market coverage report

stories.title: Ledger performance, XIRR and benchmarks
stories.user_need: Compare money-weighted history without invented cash flows.
acceptance_criteria: Consume approved L1 ledger/read/sufficiency contracts; compute XIRR and holdings only where required cash flows and prices exist, otherwise show supported partial analysis.
Specify GBP overview/local detail, FX date, fees/income/corporate-action and return conventions; choose holding, blended-portfolio and global equity benchmarks.
Use decimal money and independent known-answer reconciliation cases; never infer transactions from a holdings snapshot to manufacture XIRR.
required_evidence: L1 contract join cases; financial golden fixtures; benchmark methodology approval

stories.title: Portfolio exposure and risk facts
stories.user_need: Recognise concentration, overlap and both loss measures.
acceptance_criteria: Show portfolio/holding decline from peak and loss versus cost basis separately with explicit windows and missing-data eligibility.
Retain confirmed portfolio 10%/20% and holding 15%/25% warning/severe defaults as configurable, requiring agreed measurement/portfolio-priority weights.
Compute exposure/overlap/HHI/currency and scenario facts only from dated evidence; label provisional proxy or missing holdings exposure.
required_evidence: Risk formula/window decision; concentration/loss golden fixtures; incomplete-cost/exposure cases

stories.title: Daily and market-aware refresh orchestration
stories.user_need: See accurate freshness without excessive background calls.
acceptance_criteria: Separate daily formal forecast readiness from supported 30-minute quote/risk schedules and broader daily research refresh.
Define per-market completion/watermark and last-success/next-due states; retries cannot create duplicate forecasts or hide missed jobs.
Budget batching, source quota, catch-up and throttled loops before enabling schedules.
required_evidence: Market schedule examples; closed-market/missed-run cases; quota/cost envelope

stories.title: Forecast tasks, calendars and mature labels
stories.user_need: Read each horizon with an exact statistical meaning.
acceptance_criteria: Define next trading day,5/20 trading days and3/6/12months: target, total/price/excess return, currency, calendar target date, maturity and correction policy.
Preserve3–5-year assumption-based scenarios separately; no score or maturity label implies future outcomes have already occurred.
Each prediction pins as-of/cutoff/task/horizon/model/calibration/data/code and probability or interval interpretation.
required_evidence: ForecastTask examples for every horizon/market; maturity/holiday/correction cases

stories.title: Transparent rule and statistical baseline
stories.user_need: Have interpretable comparisons before a challenger is trusted.
acceptance_criteria: Specify the retained indicators/pillars, seeds/lookbacks and macro-basket completeness from forecasting-scope; NAV series do not receive fake candle features.
Implement only after approval: known-answer rules plus naïve/trend and reproducible bootstrap/linear baselines with explicit uncertainty meaning.
Distinguish rule strength from calibrated probabilities; preserve disabled/insufficient/no-clear-view states.
required_evidence: Indicator and baseline contracts; per-kind golden fixtures; seeded replay report

stories.title: Walk-forward backtest and leakage controls
stories.user_need: Judge forecasts using evidence that excludes the future.
acceptance_criteria: Use temporal walk-forward folds with horizon-aware purge/embargo and train-only transforms/calibration; deliberately leaky fixtures must fail.
Record dataset hashes, code/feature/model versions, split dates, fees/spreads/income/FX, survivorship and history limits.
Report calibration/error/coverage/turnover/growth/drawdown/sample intervals and benchmarks; decide objective trade-offs and evidence thresholds before promotion.
required_evidence: F1/F2 replay specification; leakage negative cases; reproducibility and subgroup report

stories.title: Risk regimes, analogs and event studies
stories.user_need: Understand uncertainty around similar conditions without overstating sparse events.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve F3 regimes/volatility/downside and F4 analog/event modules with past-only smoothing, horizon-aware neighbour exclusion and uncertainty.
Numerical code computes event count/spread/interval; overlapping outcomes and multiple testing are accounted for.
Sparse/biased event data and missing point-in-time events yield low-evidence/unavailable states rather than a confident effect.
required_evidence: F3/F4 schemas; analog overlap/leakage tests; market/event subgroup evidence

stories.title: Directional and distribution challengers
stories.user_need: Compare better models without losing the baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve F5 tree/gradient challenger, direction/quantiles/calibration and interpretable drivers; conformal labels require demonstrated time-series coverage.
Run R0 rules/statistical→M1 numerical→M2 LLM-structured features→M3 approved family ablations, measuring incremental cost and evidence.
Choose A/B execution via PH00 ADR; no training calls or artefact promotion authorised by this story draft.
required_evidence: Model adapter/evaluation pack; ablation and calibration plan; resource/cost estimate

stories.title: Pattern detectors and contribution experiments
stories.user_need: Test patterns and portfolio ideas without treating them as orders.
acceptance_criteria: Retain F8 candle/chart/technical detectors with hand-marked examples, confirmation lag, per-kind eligibility and false-discovery/out-of-sample controls.
Retain F7 contribution/rebalance scenarios, protected positions/bands and fees, comparing downside improvement against lost growth.
Scenario assumptions and owner decision journal remain explicit; no broker credential or executable order exists.
required_evidence: F7/F8 contracts and golden examples; strategy replay; no-trading cases

stories.title: Immutable forecast/outcome scorecards
stories.user_need: Inspect the record including failures and later corrections.
acceptance_criteria: Append forecasts, revisions, mature outcomes and corrections; never overwrite unsuccessful predictions or score before maturity.
Show proof/eligibility, horizon/holding/model/regime track record and30/90/365-day summaries with sample sufficiency and censoring.
Durable audit and raw score evidence survive operational log expiry.
required_evidence: Prediction/outcome schema; maturity/revision invariants; scorecard reconciliation

stories.title: Challenger shadow, owner promotion and rollback
stories.user_need: Keep control over changes to live numerical decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Require baseline/mature-outcome evidence then shadow observation and explicit owner approval for every live model/calibration/strategy change.
Agree per-horizon metric thresholds, effectively independent sample sufficiency, shadow duration, subgroup gates and probation; eight weeks does not validate 12 months.
Pin previous compatible model/data/feature/calibration pointers; failed or drifted candidate stays disabled and rollback preserves audit.
required_evidence: Promotion evidence contract; approval/rejection/rollback walkthrough; immature-evidence rejection cases

stories.title: Evidence ingestion and structured LLM factors
stories.user_need: Know where research claims and model features came from.
acceptance_criteria: Capture citations/content hashes/publication/known-at/extraction times and rights for news/filings/events/exposures; deduplicate and quarantine untrusted material.
Version extraction prompt/model/schema/confidence and tag possible hindsight in retrospective article extraction.
News sentiment/factors remain shadow until prospective or justified point-in-time ablation evidence permits approved use.
required_evidence: Evidence/factor contracts; source injection and time-contamination cases; citation audit

stories.title: Bounded direct Anthropic client-SDK agent runtime
stories.user_need: Get research without uncontrolled tools or spending.
acceptance_criteria: Specify official Python client-SDK loop on Lambda, direct Claude-hosted inference and typed validated tool results; do not use Anthropic Agent SDK subprocess runtime.
Nine reference responsibilities have allowlisted read-only scopes, budgets, timeout/turn/token caps and durable continuation/cancellation; roles need not all invoke an LLM.
Agents cannot trade, fetch secrets, alter ledger truth, edit model weights or promote themselves; budget admission precedes calls including evaluations.
required_evidence: AgentManifest/tool schemas; denied-tool/timeout/continuation cases; cost trace

stories.title: Contextual chat and research cards
stories.user_need: Ask about holdings and candidates with visible supporting evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Retain stance/profile/overlap/benchmark/bull-bear/scenario/valuation/earnings cards and shared cross-device conversation context.
Bound bull/bear to two arguments plus adjudication; source claims and numerics resolve to permitted evidence and deterministic calculators.
Chat cannot bypass forecast eligibility or fabricate missing prices/history; technical detail/glossary expand from concise answers.
required_evidence: Card/conversation API examples; citation/numerical/abstention cases; UX context walkthrough

stories.title: Layered safety and quality evaluations
stories.user_need: Know the combined system follows boundaries as well as sounding plausible.
acceptance_criteria: Specify T0 deterministic checks,T1 bounded model cases,T2 end-to-end capability/safety cases plus online checks, sampled judges and owner calibration.
Test prompt injection, identity/privacy/cross-env leakage, ungrounded numbers, citation failures, no-trading and budget exhaustion; LLM judges do not replace realised outcomes.
Keep eval provenance/cost and human disagreement; approve release thresholds before activation.
required_evidence: Evaluation pack and adversarial corpus; gate thresholds; human-calibration protocol

stories.title: Owner settings, approvals and scope controls
stories.user_need: Review a change before it affects financial research.
acceptance_criteria: Version schemas/ranges for risk/ranking/agent settings; show proposed impact,evidence,cost and rollback before sensitive approval.
Record verified owner decisions and reject stale/replayed approvals; denied requests cannot retry endlessly.
A configuration change cannot grant broader tools, sources, budgets or infrastructure authority.
required_evidence: Approval/settings state machine; stale/replay and privilege-boundary cases

stories.title: Scoped memory and cache economics
stories.user_need: Reuse context while retaining control over remembered information.
acceptance_criteria: Keep owner-visible scoped notes, correction/forget controls, taint and source audit; notes cannot replace ledger values or approved settings.
Bound context and cache stable prefixes only within privacy scopes; measure savings and all cache costs.
Deletion/correction policy covers note derivatives without deleting required durable financial audit evidence.
required_evidence: Memory/cache schemas and retention join; isolation/forgetting cases; cache cost evidence

stories.title: Discovery-first web dashboard with launch cost visibility
stories.user_need: Find useful research and operating limits at a glance.
acceptance_criteria: Adaptive accessible PWA opens on discovery/market view with main-dashboard costs, freshness, eligibility and separate holdings navigation.
Search/filter/saved watchlists include unowned candidates, peers/benchmarks/themes and impact on current overlap.
Use approved local design/package baseline; static Sites concept does not count as the PWA.
required_evidence: Web state matrix and local design selection; eventual accessibility/visual evidence; cost join cases

stories.title: Transparent ranked actions and disagreement
stories.user_need: Understand why an action is suggested and when no action is justified.
acceptance_criteria: Show add/hold/pause/trim/rebalance with holdings/candidate distinction,reasons,uncertainty,portfolio impact and horizon.
Apply eligibility/abstention before the combined 35% growth/40% protection/25% opportunity ranking, with component scores and agreed normalization/tie/action bands.
Expose rules,ML and LLM-assisted views separately; disagreement and unavailable inputs cannot be hidden by a single score.
required_evidence: Ranking formula/action-band approval; missing/conflicting/tied case matrix; deterministic reference outputs

stories.title: Balanced horizon proof and scenario experience
stories.user_need: Compare short and long horizons without a false accuracy impression.
acceptance_criteria: Show nextday/5/20days, 3/6/12 months and separate 3–5-year scenario sections with cutoff,uncertainty,eligibility and evidence.
F6 side-by-side explanation, fan/range charts, regime/analog/event/pattern sheets and model/track-record proof remain accessible.
No-model/in-practice/disabled/stale/unavailable states work in chart and text alternatives; simple/technical modes preserve material uncertainty.
required_evidence: Per-horizon state inventory; accessibility text alternatives; forecast/proof API join evidence

stories.title: Daily brief, risk alerts and decision journal
stories.user_need: Receive useful changes without excessive or misleading interruption.
acceptance_criteria: Action-first summary 07:30 Europe/London with per-market timestamps, priorities,risks,changes and upcoming events; quiet hours 22:00–07:00.
Define material/critical thresholds,weekends,cooldown,dedup and denied-push fallback; immediate means after detection using available cadence.
Retain in-app/chat alerts,wrap/reflection requirements and I-acted journal; no alert executes an action.
required_evidence: Notification/briefing state table; DST/quiet/missed/duplicate cases; privacy-safe payload examples

stories.title: Web import, audit and recovery journey joins
stories.user_need: Complete a coherent daily web flow across the separate layers.
acceptance_criteria: Consume detailed L1 preview/confirm/reversal/partial-history flows without diverging from canonical ledger contracts.
Join source→ledger→risk→forecast→action→outcome→audit with clear error/stale/permission states.
Cross-client deep links retrieve durable authorized state; offline mode labels cached ages and blocks unsafe writes.
required_evidence: L1 story trace links; full journey walkthrough; offline/reconnect/error scenarios

stories.title: Native SwiftUI within React Native shell
stories.user_need: Use the core product natively on iPhone and iPad.
acceptance_criteria: Swift owns native views,persistence,widgets and secure-device integration; RN shell owns navigation/bridge contracts.
Deliver approved adaptive dashboard,holdings,imports,forecast/proof,chat,cost and approval journeys across iPhone/iPad/Duo matrix.
Test shared API/event and shell/native schema compatibility and discoverable error/recovery states.
required_evidence: Bridge contract; device/OS acceptance matrix; native snapshots and contract results

stories.title: Offline cache, privacy and accessibility
stories.user_need: Read the last trusted state safely on any supported device.
acceptance_criteria: Encrypt/cache only approved data,display per-record age,refetch after reconnect and revoke access/session caches appropriately.
VoiceOver,Dynamic Type,reduced motion,focus/chart alternatives and large/adaptive layouts satisfy agreed acceptance.
No confidential holdings appear on lockscreen,app snapshots or exported share content by default without approved settings.
required_evidence: Offline/revoked-session tests; native accessibility walkthrough; privacy state matrix

stories.title: PWA/native push and permission fallbacks
stories.user_need: Receive the same material alert within actual platform constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Implement first-version app/chat,native and PWA push per verified OS/browser capability and user permission.
Use durable outbox,dedup/deep links,quiet hours and neutral payloads; denied/background-disabled delivery remains visible in-app.
Measure delivery limitations; do not promise instant OS delivery or infer no risk from silence.
required_evidence: Supported-platform evidence; permission/quiet/duplicate/deep-link cases

stories.title: Native capability backlog without hidden scope loss
stories.user_need: Retain useful device integrations while keeping activation bounded.
acceptance_criteria: Specify widgets,share-sheet intake,search/deep links,Siri/AppIntents and long-job Live Activities with privacy,availability and cost constraints.
Classify each capability launch-required or later activation by explicit owner choice; no silent removal of inherited scope.
Keep Android product screens outside current agreed release scope; RN shell does not imply an Android UI.
required_evidence: Capability/release decision table; platform fallback and privacy examples

stories.title: Release readiness and reconciled actual-input onboarding
stories.user_need: Enable only the scope backed by approved evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Require approved full baseline/UX,per-layer acceptance and whole-product contracts/evidence; no Jira status proves release readiness.
Actual holdings/listings/documents may be added progressively; verify identity,source entitlements and named layout coverage before their real use, retaining unsupported review/manual paths.
No live claims or training accuracy derives from synthetic fixtures; no deployment/spend follows automatically from draft approval.
required_evidence: Release trace/coverage matrix; named-live-universe and layout sign-off; remaining-gap decision

stories.title: Restore, rollback and monthly audit exercises
stories.user_need: Recover the portfolio and its evidence together.
acceptance_criteria: Agree RPO/RTO by record class,perform monthly focused exercises plus relevant storage/import/audit change checks.
Restore original versions,ledger,audit,outcomes,approval and model pointers into isolated recovery target and reconcile counts/hashes/financial balances.
Exercise rollback of app/contracts/model/calibration and failed import reversal; no destructive restore into production or automatic expiry deletion.
required_evidence: Recovery runbook and approved targets; isolated restore report; source-to-record reconciliation

stories.title: Resilience, incidents and bounded self-recovery
stories.user_need: Recognise and recover failed jobs without duplicate or unauthorized work.
acceptance_criteria: Test queue/DLQ/replay limits,out-of-order conversation events,market outage,missed forecast,expired source access and stalled collector.
Self-recovery uses approved bounded actions only; no agent may edit infrastructure or buy a provider.
Correlate alert→incident→run→source/model evidence; avoid hidden lost events behind a healthy service health endpoint.
required_evidence: Failure injection matrix; replay/idempotency audit; missed-job and billing-stale alerts

stories.title: Whole-release security, scientific and cost gates
stories.user_need: Evaluate the actual planned launch load before activation.
acceptance_criteria: Run relevant API/schema/ledger/scientific/no-leakage/agent/accessibility/native/offline/privacy/security gates before any separately approved independent review.
Demonstrate full launch usage and budget fallbacks within £100 aggregate,including dev/prod/evals/collectors/SSE/backups/builds and unverified/no credit cases.
Review blockers,non-blocking issues and rollback readiness; live model gate remains separate from application release approval.
required_evidence: Risk-based gate report; per-market/horizon coverage; aggregate cost and credit failure evidence

stories.title: Owner operations and admin requirements
stories.user_need: Investigate sources, costs and changes without losing daily usability.
acceptance_criteria: Capture admin requirements now: uploads/versions,ledger updates,runs/tools/models/evals,health,cost and approvals; owner designs the full portal later.
Ship required audit/owner controls in approved launch UX; later portal styling does not defer main-dashboard cost visibility or critical recovery controls.
Retain pause switches,incident escalation,monthly evidence review and documented owner procedures.
required_evidence: Admin requirements/permission inventory; launch-versus-later UX decision; operations walkthrough

stories.title: Validated market and instrument extensions
stories.user_need: Expand beyond the initial markets without treating config as proof.
acceptance_criteria: Use versioned MarketProfile/InstrumentKind/DataSource contracts for mainland China,Taiwan,Hong Kong and continental Europe as later scope.
Check venue/calendar/currency/dual-listing mappings,rights,history,delay and budget; unsupported handlers need tested code and approved deployment.
Each market/kind receives contract,replay,shadow and owner activation evidence; avoid projecting US-only validation across markets.
required_evidence: Extension admission checklist; hypothetical region/kind cases; incremental cost/rights evidence before activation

stories.title: Themes, segments and bounded broad-universe research
stories.user_need: Explore solar/clean-energy themes without buying uncontrolled inference.
acceptance_criteria: Version dated many-to-many theme membership and sources; distinguish marketing labels from measured economic exposures.
Use batched daily quantitative screening and a bounded LLM shortlist; compare themes/peers/benchmarks and holdings overlap.
Historical theme studies use historical constituents; expanded universe/data/model load must fit approved aggregate cost.
required_evidence: Theme/screen contracts; look-ahead/overlap cases; bounded workload plan

stories.title: New features, model families and horizons
stories.user_need: Improve the system through explicit compatible experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Version FeatureSet/ModelAdapter/ForecastTask/Strategy/AgentManifest/EvaluationPack schemas and supported capability matrix.
New computation requires tested trusted code,resource costing,ablation/mature outcomes/shadow evidence and owner promotion.
No arbitrary runtime code/plugin download or self-authorized model/tool/budget expansion.
required_evidence: Plugin compatibility suite plan; admission/rejection examples; owner rollout protocol

stories.title: Optional MA interchange and eventual retirement boundary
stories.user_need: Keep the standalone product independent and preserve existing MA capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: No shared live database or required MA API; any optional export/import needs an approved versioned file contract and reconciliation.
Before any later MA advanced-Forecaster retirement,refresh source/code/runtime inventory,prove agreed parity/history preservation,recovery and explicit cutover scope.
MA rules,tracking and XIRR remain; no MA page/issue/source/runtime change is authorized by this plan or its MP story mapping.
required_evidence: Boundary ADR; conditional parity/cutover checklist; explicit not-authorized record
